page.overview:
Who is Dagon?

Dagon is the co-owner of the Midnight Breath Tavern in Vasselheim. As an NPC, Dagon is played by Matthew Mercer.

Dagon is an older human man with a patchy red-and-brown beard. He has a few scars, but they seem to be more of a result of living in the harsh landscape of Vasselheim than from any battle.

Dagon has a brother in Muldire, more than two days' horseback ride northwest of Vasselheim.

To be pardoned by the Slayer's Take, Vox Machina had to kill an adult white dragon. They found Dagon, who told them where he had encountered such a creature.
